detail.longDescription: So, I've created my own OS called LimonOS. It is currently in the early stages of development. Its uniqueness lies in the fact that it is neither Linux nor Unix—in short, the kernel is unique and 98% written in C. Yes, I used an AI assistant for help because I had a headache and encountered many errors and problems since I was working on it and thinking through it alone. Development has been ongoing for 4 days. Here is the link to the OS itself—we recently added a browser and internet connection: https://github.com/AnonimusShamshiAlex/LimonOS The code and the entire OS system are there. There is a catch: if you are on Windows, you need to click on the batch file, and everything will compile using WSL Linux and Limine for implementation. Everything is on GitHub, including all instructions, and it will probably be easiest for you to check it out in a virtual machine. I'm writing this because I want your opinion and advice on how to improve this OS system so that it works and becomes as stable as other operating systems like Linux. It's cool to build my own OS like Terry Davis, and I hope I don't become a maniac. Here are some screenshots of the interface: Thank you everyone. I recently added AI to the terminal, which you can connect to via the command: aikey <your openrouter.ai API key here> then you can use it with the command ai: ai hi my name Jucy here are the screenshots of the interface in github https://github.com/AnonimusShamshiAlex/LimonOS
